contexts.text: The Spirits of Mercury... approached the Earth Venus... which indicated that those Spirits of Venus who were on that side of the planet, agreed with those of the planet Mercury; and that the former relate to the memory of material Things, which agrees with the memory of immaterial Things... SE 1443. SE 1445, Explained. SE 1446:end. SE 1448.
The planet Venus appears (in the ideas of Spirits) to the left, a little behind. AC 7247.
On the inhabitants and Spirits of the planet Venus. General article. EU 105. SE 1441.

In the planet Venus there are two kinds of men, of contrary disposition; one being rude and almost ferine, and the other gentle and humane. (The former) appear on the side of the planet which looks this way; (the latter) on the opposite side. Explained. (The former kind fully described. AC 7248. AC 7249. SE 3346. SE 3347.) (Their state after death. AC 7250. SE 1449, Described.)
The inhabitants of Venus are for the most part giants, those of our Earth reaching only to their middle. SE 1450.

The inhabitants and Spirits of Venus who appear on the other side of that Earth... and are gentle and humane... in the world acknowledge our Lord as their only God... and see Him walking among them... SE 1453.
These latter Spirits (of Venus) relate, in the Grand Man, to the memory of material Things which corresponds to the memory of immaterial Things.
Some of the Spirits from this side who had undergone extreme vastation were into Heaven, and were received there with tenderness that they drew tears from my eyes.
The inhabitants of Venus... do not together by day, but by night, on account of heat; wherefore they have lived in darkness, yet they see.
The Spirits of the inhabitants of this side of Venus... said to me that they were solely goatherds...
They are very simple in Venus; but observe that these simple and stupid ones are represented on this side of Venus; and the situations merely signify their minds; for they are not all such.

Those who appear on the other side of Venus are worshippers of the Lord... acknowledging our only Lord... and they represented Him walking among them, almost to the life. They said that they were solely shepherds of flocks.
a. The inhabitants of the Earth Venus and of our Earth constitute corporeal things, and their appetites, thus earthly things, and also the lower worldly things; thus they rule the external senses.
